source_passage: Specialty furniture retailer with no confirmed breach, ransomware or OAIC NDB found in any reviewed source — a 'no evidence found' result, not a verified clean record. Consumer retail is lower data-sensitivity than IT/telco/financial/health. Residual exposure exists: direct e-commerce plus Plush and UK Fabb brands, ~112 stores processing customer PII, deposits and consumer-finance applications, and lookalike/scam-site complaints. A recent auditor change (EY to KPMG, FY2024→FY2025) is a control-environment signal worth an underwriting question. Lowest amenability of the Australian set. No confirmed breach/ransomware/OAIC NDB found as of Jun 2026 ('no evidence found', not a verified clean record) Governance signal (not an incident): external auditor changed from EY to KPMG between FY2024 and FY2025; no qualified opinion or breach reported Inherent exposure (not an incident): e-commerce + Plush + UK Fabb brands and ~112 stores process PII, deposits and consumer-finance; lookalike/scam-site complaints raise brand-impersonation/phishing risk against customers Subsidiary: Plush-Think Sofas (acquired Nov 2021, ~A$110m from Greenlit Brands) Subsidiary: Anglia Home Furnishings / Fabb Furniture UK (acquired May 2024; rebranding to Nick Scali) Vendor: Greenlit Brands (sold Plush) Former auditor: EY (through FY2023/FY2024); current auditor: KPMG (from FY2025) Substantial shareholders: Magellan (~8.2%), Scali Consolidated (~7.9%), Perpetual (~7.5%) Competitors: Harvey Norman, Adairs, Temple & Webster
